newsitem.title: USA: Country Maid knows no reason for activity.
newsitem.headline: Country Maid knows no reason for activity.

text.p: Country Maid Foods Inc said it was "unaware of any reason for the recent activity in the volume and price of its common stock."
Shares in the egg producer and agricultural importer-exporter were up $0.01 to $0.17 per share.
"The company is in the best shape of its corporate life, due to recent acquisitions and the continued relative stability of the commercial egg market," said president John Moneymaker.

"We are working on the assimilation of the commercial egg-breaking facility into our operation and looking forward to completing two additional acquisitions prior to the end of the year, which will assist our revenue growth and help our international presence in the marketplace," Moneymaker said.
